messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api request-queue growth detected in us-east-1 (p95 -> 1.8s, p99 -> 8.2s), GPU pool saturation. auto-escalation to #incidents.
ops_jamie: seeing queue depth jump ~7x in the last 3m, provisioner creating nodes but tasks stuck in Pending. prob: provisioner heartbeat timeouts.
eng_oncall_maya: oncall here. tagging @sre_kiran and @prod_support_lee. any customer-visible errors?
prod_support_lee: support dashboard shows spike from customer AcmeAds campaign, many 429s/timeouts reported. customer is seeing 50% errors for image-gen route.
sre_kiran: checking autoscaler logs now. quick grep shows scale_loop hit max_pools=18 and provisioner retries failing with: 
```
ERROR provisioner: heartbeat timeout to provisioner-agent (attempt 12)
WARN autoscaler: reached max_pools, cannot provision new GPU nodes
```
ops_jamie: so autoscaler won't add capacity because of config cap. Can we temporarily bump max_pools?
eng_oncall_maya: we can, but control-plane quota in us-east is 120 GPUs total; current usage 116. If we bump, might hit infra-wide quota. Suggest immediate mitigations first: traffic shaping + fallback model.
prod_support_lee: notified AcmeAds account team, they're turning off campaign in 10m if we don't remediate. Need a quick SLA estimate.
sre_kiran: mitigation plan: 1) enable soft-throttle at edge for large customers (limit bursts) 2) route 25% of traffic for image-gen to a smaller quantized model variant (gpt-image-lite-8q) 3) enable emergency dedicated pool for top-tier customers (if infra quota allows)
eng_oncall_maya: executing plan: (1) applying edge throttle rule now via waf-proxy: `wafctl set-rate-limit --route /v1/image-gen --key customer_id --rate 10r/s`
ops_jamie: applied. monitoring for Q reduction.
sre_kiran: (2) creating temporary routing policy: route weight 25% -> gpt-image-lite-8q. patching traffic-router: 
```
PATCH /routing/policies/active
{"route":"/v1/image-gen","weights":{"gpt-image-v2":75,"gpt-image-lite-8q":25}}
```
eng_oncall_maya: patched. watch logs for errors from quantized model.
prod_support_lee: Acme rep online: cust_acme_rep: we're seeing some drop already, thanks. They want ETA for full restoration.
sre_kiran: queue depth halved in 2m. p95 down to 700ms, p99 down to 2.5s. still elevated but improving.
ops_jamie: infra quota shows 3 GPUs free if we bump pooled limit — can create 1 extra node. provisioning still flaky due to heartbeat flaps; suspect transient network TOs to provisioner agent.
eng_oncall_maya: spinning up 1 emergency node manually via infra-console (bypass provisioner autoscale). if that attaches, we'll relieve contention.
ops_jamie: manual node in, pods scheduling. backlog dropping.
prod_support_lee: Acme says errors down to ~8%. Asking for postmortem and action items.
sre_kiran: immediate follow-ups: (a) investigate provisioner heartbeat timeouts (network team + agent upgrade) (b) revisit max_pools policy for emergency bursts (c) add throttling guardrails per-customer to avoid single-customer blast radius (d) run chaos test for provisioner under high churn.
eng_oncall_maya: jotting action items and owners. tagging tickets: PROV-412 (heartbeat debug) -> @eng_infra, QUOTA-98 (emergency pool policy) -> @product, THROTTLE-77 (per-customer throttle default) -> @devex.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (edge throttle + 25% fallback + manual node). customer impact reduced. Pager cleared for now.
ops_jamie: leaving notes: if we see another spike, escalate to infra-ops to temporarily increase regional GPU quota, and prepare a pre-baked dedicated pool for top-tier customers.
prod_support_lee: will follow up with Acme success team and confirm campaign pause.
eng_oncall_maya: closing on-call for this thread, handoff to eng_infra for root cause and to product for policy work. leaving channel open for 2h watch. :white_check_mark:
cust_acme_rep: thanks team, will confirm once campaign completely stopped.
eng_oncall_maya: final metrics snapshot: pre-mitigation p95 1.8s p99 8.2s errors ~48%; post-mitigation p95 0.7s p99 2.5s errors ~7%. saved ~3 nodes worth of capacity via fallback+throttle.
ops_jamie: note for postmortem: capture timing of provisioner-agent heartbeat failures (timestamps attached to PROV-412).
prod_support_lee: assigning customer comms to AM.
eng_oncall_maya: thanks all. will open a short postmortem thread once root cause confirmed. :memo:
